title: Astrid and the Border
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Jude Okonkwo, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
